job.title: Accounts Administrator
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Part-Time Accounts Administrator to join a friendly business in Wellingborough on a 12-week temporary assignment.
This is a flexible opportunity ideally suited to someone with previous purchase ledger and sales ledger experience who is looking for part-time hours. We can accommodate school hours, three full days, or shorter hours spread across four or five days.

Part-Time Accounts Administrator – Purchase & Sales Ledger Location: Wellingborough, Northamptonshire
Contract: Temporary, 12 weeks
Hours: 2–3 days per week / flexible part-time hours

The role Your responsibilities will include:
  • Processing purchase ledger invoices
  • Sales ledger administration
  • Matching and checking invoices
  • Processing payments and receipts
  • Reconciling supplier/customer accounts
  • Dealing with invoice and payment queries
  • Maintaining accurate accounting records
  • General accounts and administrative support as required
Hours There is plenty of flexibility around how the hours are worked within our normal office hours of Monday to Friday, 8:30am–5:30pm.
For example:
  • 3 full days per week
  • 4–5 shorter days
  • School hours
  • Alternative arrangements across 2–3 days may also be considered
About you You will ideally have:
  • Previous purchase ledger and/or sales ledger experience
  • Good attention to detail and accuracy
  • Confident IT and Excel skills
  • A well-organised and reliable approach
  • The ability to work independently and manage your workload
This is a great opportunity for someone looking for a short-term, flexible accounts position in Wellingborough, particularly if you need working hours to fit around other commitments.

For more information please apply and/ or speak with Julie Warner at Warner Recruitment, looking forward to receiving your application.

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
Are you looking for an Assistant Accountant role where you can build on the accounting experience you’ve already gained, while working closely with someone who will genuinely support your development?
You’ll work closely with the Financial Controller (ACCA qualified) who is genuinely looking forward to supporting, training and developing you in the role.
This is a great opportunity to gain broader accounting experience, strengthen your month-end skills and continue progressing professionally.
The role Working closely with the Financial Controller and wider finance team, you’ll be involved in:
  • Assisting with monthly management accounts
  • Preparing accruals and prepayments
  • Posting journals
  • Completing balance sheet reconciliations
  • Supporting budgeting and forecasting
  • Assisting with VAT returns and year-end requirements
  • Maintaining accurate financial records
  • Supporting the wider finance team with ad hoc analysis and projects
This isn’t an entry-level accounts role; you’ll need previous practical experience working within an accounts or finance team, including experience with accruals, prepayments and journals.

In terms of qualifications, you may be:
  • AAT qualified or currently studying towards AAT (or equivalent) 
  • A graduate with a degree in Accounting & Finance, alongside practical accounts experience
  • Looking to start studying towards ACCA or CIMA (or equivalent)
  • Already in the early stages of your ACCA or CIMA studies (or equivalent)
Benefits:
  • 25 days holiday
  • 5% pension contribution
  • Holiday purchase upto 5 days
  • Potential for study support
Interested? If you’re interested in this Assistant Accountant opportunity and would like to find out more, please apply and/or contact Julie Warner at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
Are you an experienced qualified ACA/ ACCA/ CIMA (or equivalent) Financial Controller who can quickly get to grips with the finance function and keep everything running smoothly?  The company turn over circa £6million and you will have sole responsibility of the company finances from ledgers through to month end reporting and presenting to the board.
This established, stable family business in Wellingborough is looking for an Interim Financial Controller to provide cover between their current Financial Controller retiring in December and their new permanent Financial Controller starting in Q1 2027.
It’s a broad, hands-on and autonomous role where you’ll take full responsibility for the finance function, working directly with the business owners. They need someone experienced and dependable who can pick things up quickly and provide continuity during this transition.

Interim Financial Controller Wellingborough, Northamptonshire, circa 12 weeks, fully office based

Key Responsibilities
  • Full ownership of the finance function
  • Month-end reporting
  • Cash flow management and forecasting
  • P&L and balance sheet reporting
  • Producing the trial balance
  • Providing clear financial information to the business owners
  • Accruals and prepayments
  • Maintaining the fixed asset register
  • Posting journals
  • Purchase and sales ledger
  • Bank reconciliations
  • VAT returns
  • Running BACS payments
  • Credit control
  • Maintaining strong financial controls and processes
  • Supporting the owners with financial information and commercial decisions
What We’re Looking For You’ll be an experienced qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA or CIMA, or equivalent) who can step into a broad Financial Controller role and take ownership from day one.
You’ll be:
  • ACCA, ACA or CIMA qualified (or equivalent)
  • An experienced Financial Controller with a strong hands-on accounting background
  • Comfortable working as the sole finance person and taking full ownership of the finance function
  • Confident managing month end, cash flow, P&L, balance sheet and financial reporting
  • Able to communicate clearly with business owners and non-finance colleagues
  • Practical, organised and able to get up to speed quickly
If you would like to find out more, please apply and/or contact Julie Warner at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Are you an experience accountant, qualified/ part qualified in ACA/ ACCA/ CIMA (or equivalent) or qualified by experience; and enjoy taking ownership of management accounts, getting into the detail and making sure the numbers are accurate?
This is a great opportunity to join a well-established business in a varied, hands-on accounting role, working closely with the Financial Controller and wider finance team.
You’ll be involved in producing monthly management accounts across the businesses and head office, alongside reconciliations, journals, VAT, cash reporting and supporting the year-end audit.
 
What will you be doing?
  • Supporting the production of monthly management accounts
  • Preparing accruals, prepayments and month-end journals
  • Completing balance sheet and nominal ledger reconciliations
  • Investigating variances and ensuring financial information is accurate
  • Completing cashbook postings, bank reconciliations and cash reporting
  • Maintaining management accounts spreadsheets and supporting schedules
  • Reviewing overhead postings and processing adjustments
  • Preparing the VAT return
  • Overseeing expenses and associated accounting entries
  • Supporting invoice processing and payment controls
  • Supporting the annual budgeting process
  • Providing information and analysis for the annual audit and tax return
 
What are we looking for?
  • Part-qualified/ fully qualified ACA / ACCA/ CIMA (or equivalent) or qualified by experience (QBE).
  • Someone who takes ownership, gets into the detail and takes pride in getting things right.
  • Organised and accurate, with the ability to manage competing priorities and month-end deadlines.
  • Proactive and inquisitive, happy to investigate
  • A confident team player who communicates well with colleagues across the business and enjoys finding better ways of doing things.
 
If you’re interested in this Accountant opportunity and would like to know more, please apply or contact Julie Warner at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Credit Controller
job.description:
Are you an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys taking ownership, building relationships and successfully collecting outstanding debt?
This is a great opportunity to join the finance team of a well-established business, working closely with the Finance Manager and colleagues across the wider organisation.
It’s a hands-on role with plenty of variety. You’ll take ownership of the day-to-day credit control function, proactively managing customer accounts and collections, alongside cash allocation, reporting, invoicing and reconciliations.
 
What will you be doing?
  • Taking ownership of credit control across the business
  • Proactively chasing overdue payments by phone and email
  • Building positive relationships with customers to resolve payment queries
  • Allocating incoming payments
  • Reconciling customer accounts
  • Carrying out credit checks on new and existing customers
  • Producing accurate credit control and aged debt reports
  • Highlighting risks, disputed accounts and areas requiring action
  • Producing manual invoices and maintaining accurate cashbook records
  • Working closely with internal teams to improve collections and cash flow
  • Supporting other members of the team when required
 
What are we looking for?
  • Previous experience within credit control
  • Confidence chasing outstanding payments professionally
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills
  • The ability to organise and prioritise your workload
  • A proactive approach to resolving queries
  • A friendly, confident and professional communication style
 
If you’re interested in this Credit Controller opportunity and would like to know more, please apply or contact Julie Warner at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

Financial Controller (ACCA, ACA, CIMA, AAT or QBE)
Wellingborough, Northamptonshire • Established Family Business • Autonomous Role
Key Responsibilities
  • Full ownership of the finance function
  • Month-end reporting
  • Cash flow management and forecasting
  • P&L and balance sheet reporting
  • Producing the trial balance

  • Accruals and prepayments

Finance Business Partner
Northampton
